title: H2DF：用于可控语言模型遗忘的校准目标区间
summary: 提出H2DF，一种校准目标区间目标函数，用于语言模型遗忘。它在数据相关下界以下施加类似梯度上升的压力，达到目标区间后抑制或反转该压力，从而控制遗忘强度、保护保留效用，并在TOFU和MUSE-News上验证效果。
summary_en: H2DF introduces a calibrated target-band objective for language-model unlearning: it applies GA-like pressure below a data-dependent lower target and suppresses or reverses it once the target region is reached, controlling forgetting strength while preserving retained utility, validated on TOFU and MUSE-News.
